mcqs.learning_point: Understand the cell as the basic unit of life
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is a common misconception about cells?

options.A: All living organisms are composed of cells.
options.B: Cells are the basic structural and functional units of life.
options.C: Only animal bodies are made up of cells, plants are not cellular.
options.D: Cells can arise spontaneously from non‑living matter.

mcqs.answer: Only animal bodies are made up of cells, plants are not cellular.
mcqs.explanation: Option C is a misconception because plants, like animals, are also made up of cells. Options A and B correctly describe cells, and option D is also false but the question asks for a common misconception; the idea that only animals are cellular is a widely held incorrect belief.

mcqs.learning_point: State the basic ideas of cell theory
mcqs.question: Which statement correctly summarizes all three main tenets of the cell theory?

options.A: All living organisms are composed of cells; the cell is the basic unit of life; all cells arise from pre‑existing cells.
options.B: Cells can arise spontaneously from non‑living matter; cells are the smallest unit of life; all organisms are made of cells.
options.C: Only plants are made of cells; cells can be created de novo; cells are the functional unit of life.
options.D: Cells are only structural units; they do not perform functions; they arise from non‑living matter.

mcqs.answer: All living organisms are composed of cells; the cell is the basic unit of life; all cells arise from pre‑existing cells.
mcqs.explanation: Option A contains the three accepted statements of the cell theory: (1) all living things are made of cells, (2) the cell is the fundamental unit of structure and function, and (3) cells arise only from existing cells. The other options include false ideas such as spontaneous generation or limiting cells to plants only.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes unicellular from multicellular organisms?

options.A: Unicellular organisms consist of a single cell that performs all life processes, whereas multicellular organisms have specialized cells performing different functions.
options.B: Unicellular organisms are always prokaryotes, while multicellular organisms are always eukaryotes.
options.C: Unicellular organisms can only be found in aquatic environments, whereas multicellular organisms live only on land.
options.D: Unicellular organisms reproduce only by binary fission, while multicellular organisms reproduce only by sexual reproduction.

mcqs.answer: Unicellular organisms consist of a single cell that performs all life processes, whereas multicellular organisms have specialized cells performing different functions.
mcqs.explanation: Option A accurately captures the key difference: a single cell handles all functions in unicellular organisms, while multicellular organisms have many cells that are often specialized. Options B, C, and D are incorrect generalizations; unicellular organisms can be eukaryotic (e.g., yeast) and can reproduce by various methods, and multicellular organisms can be aquatic as well.

mcqs.question: Which organelle is primarily responsible for producing ATP through cellular respiration in eukaryotic cells?
mcqs.explanation: Mitochondria have inner membrane folds (cristae) that increase surface area for oxidative phosphorylation, the process that synthesizes ATP. The nucleus stores genetic material, chloroplasts conduct photosynthesis, and the Golgi apparatus modifies and packages proteins.

mcqs.learning_point: Understand the cell as the basic unit of life
mcqs.question: What term describes the smallest unit that can carry out all life processes?
mcqs.explanation: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit capable of performing all activities necessary for life. Tissues are groups of similar cells, organs are collections of tissues, and molecules are chemical entities, none of which alone can sustain life.

mcqs.learning_point: State the basic ideas of cell theory
mcqs.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of the cell theory?

options.A: All living organisms are composed of one or more cells.
options.B: The cell is the basic unit of structure and function in living organisms.
options.C: All cells arise from pre‑existing cells.
options.D: Cells can be created spontaneously from non‑living matter.

mcqs.answer: Cells can be created spontaneously from non‑living matter.
mcqs.explanation: The cell theory explicitly rejects spontaneous generation; it states that cells arise only from pre‑existing cells. Options A, B, and C are the three accepted statements of the theory.

mcqs.question: Which definition correctly describes a multicellular organism?

options.A: An organism made up of a single cell that performs all life functions.
options.B: An organism composed of many cells that are specialized for different functions.
options.C: An organism that can exist without any cells.
options.D: An organism that reproduces only by binary fission.

mcqs.answer: An organism composed of many cells that are specialized for different functions.
mcqs.explanation: Multicellular organisms consist of numerous cells that often differentiate to perform specific roles (e.g., muscle, nerve). Option A describes unicellular organisms, while C and D are inaccurate statements.

mcqs.question: In plant cells, which structure captures light energy to synthesize food?
mcqs.explanation: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which absorbs sunlight and uses it in photosynthesis to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose. Mitochondria generate ATP, vacuoles store substances, and ribosomes synthesize proteins.
